finding.claim: A small crafted worksheet XML forces multi-GB allocation: checkSheet sizes the row slice from the max attacker-supplied row number, and checkSheetR0 pads each row to the attacker-supplied column width (up to 16384 cells per row). Not executed; verified by reading.
finding.source: Worksheet XML content (row r attributes and cell r references), read via workSheetReader on any sheet access (excelize.go:291-331, checkSheet invoked at :328-329; GetRows rows.go:61)
finding.sink: excelize.go:395 make([]xlsxRow, row); excelize.go:420-423 padding loop appending xlsxC{} up to col

trace.note: checkSheet invoked on first read of a sheet
lastRowNum takes max row over cell references of a row
checkSheet loop: r.R==0 rows routed to r0Rows, row max computed from lastRowNum
allocates max-row-count xlsxRow slice
checkSheetR0 invoked for r0 rows
checkRow pads sheetData.Row[rowIdx].C to col
explicit cell refs in r0 rows call checkRow with the cell's own column

finding.guards_checked: checkRowNum (excelize.go:342-350) bounds only row numbers to TotalRows; no cap on total cells or padded width per row. UnzipSizeLimit bounds declared zip sizes, not the parsed expansion. Non-r0 rows do not pad, so the amplification requires r="0" or duplicate row numbers. Repro shape: one <row r="0"> with <c r="XFD1"/> through <c r="XFD1000"/> (~17 KB XML) pads ~1000 rows to 16384 cells each, roughly 16M structs (GB-scale). Impact is out-of-memory, which Go cannot recover from. Disposition VULNERABLE (Medium).

finding.claim: A small formula such as =SUM(A1:XFC1048575) makes rangeResolver materialize every cell in the range. The whole-row and whole-column collapse fires only on exact maximum bounds, so an off-by-one range materializes about 1,048,575 x 16,383 (~1.7e10) entries. Not executed; verified by reading.
finding.source: Cell formula text in an untrusted workbook, evaluated via public CalcCellValue (calc.go:878)
finding.sink: calc.go:1932-1952 nested loop appending every cell (including empty ones) into arg.Matrix

trace.note: CalcCellValue public entry
rangeResolver
range bounds taken from formula
row collapse only when valueRange[1] == TotalRows
column collapse only when valueRange[3] == MaxColumns
loop over every row in range
loop over every column in range
append each cell, including empty ones
append row to matrix

finding.guards_checked: Collapse at calc.go:1906/1917 only fires on exact bounds. MaxCalcIterations (calc.go:1824) bounds recursion through cell references, not range size. No size cap on the matrix. Cell-recursion cycles are bounded. Disposition VULNERABLE (Medium); applies only to apps that call CalcCellValue on untrusted files.

finding.claim: Malformed OLE/CFB encrypted container causes unrecovered slice-bounds panics on attacker-controlled lengths. Decrypt runs regardless of Password, so OpenReader/OpenFile can crash the process. Not executed; verified by reading.
finding.source: OLE-magic input to OpenReader/OpenFile (excelize.go:208-214); EncryptionInfo and EncryptedPackage stream contents and length fields
finding.sink: crypt.go:244-245 encryptionInfoBuf[8:12] and [12:12+encryptionHeaderSize]; crypt.go:274 encryptedPackageBuf[8:]; crypt.go:290-299 fixed-offset verifier slices; crypt.go:327 x3[:cbRequiredKeyLength]; crypt.go:413 encryptionInfoBuf[8:]; crypt.go:469-470 key[:keyBytes]

finding.guards_checked: maxStreamSize (crypt.go:202) bounds sizes only. encryptionMechanism (crypt.go:221-238) checks only minimum length 4 and version. No recover() in non-test code (grep). Impact is a process crash for callers that do not recover. Disposition VULNERABLE (Low-Medium).

finding.claim: Root-element attribute values from an untrusted workbook or worksheet are re-emitted unescaped into the output root start tag, allowing arbitrary XML elements and attributes to be injected into re-saved workbook.xml or sheet XML. Not executed; verified by reading.
finding.source: Root start-tag attribute values of input workbook.xml and worksheet XML, decoded by encoding/xml (excelize.go:320; workbook.go:259 via getRootElement lib.go:671-697)
finding.sink: lib.go:701-714 genXMLNamespace emits fmt.Sprintf("%s=\"%s\" ") with no escaping; lib.go:728-735 replaceNameSpaceBytes splices it into the output root; output sites workbook.go:283, sheet.go:181,269,1116, rows.go:347, col.go:215, styles.go:44, chart.go:1345

trace.note: worksheet root attributes read from input
workbook root attributes read from input
getRootElement returns decoded (unescaped) attributes
genXMLNamespace builds attribute text without escaping
replaceNameSpaceBytes stores the built string into output
bytesReplace substitutes xmlns="NS"> with the injected string
workbook output written with injected root

finding.guards_checked: No escaping or validation on the write side; encoding/xml only decodes on the read side. Repro shape: root attribute value foo="x"><sheetData>...<y a="" yields foo="x"><sheetData>...<y a="" in the re-saved file. Requires an app that opens untrusted XLSX, sanitizes via excelize APIs, and saves or returns it. Disposition VULNERABLE (Low-Medium); round-trip injection, not code execution.
